name: Find Mecatol Rex
text: Have found Mecatol Rex.

name: Survey the Rocks
text: Have found 1/8 of the asteroid fields in the game, rounded up and at least 2. If the game has fewer than 2, all of them.

name: Wormhole Cartographer
text: Have found systems containing half of the wormhole types currently in the game, rounded up and at least 2.

name: Catalogue the Anomalies
text: Have found 1 system of each anomaly type in the game.

name: Find the Thrones
text: Have found the home systems of 3 other players.

name: Edge of the Map
text: Have found 4 systems on the edge of the map.

name: Chart the Expanse
text: Round 3 or later: have found 2/3 of the systems on the map.

name: Master Cartographer
text: Round 3 or later: have found at least half of the systems on the map, and more systems than every other player.

name: Know More Than They Do
text: Round 3 or later: have found the home systems of 2 players who have not found yours.

name: Run Silent
text: Round 3 or later: have 3 or more capital ships (flagships, war suns, dreadnoughts, carriers) on the game board, none of them in any other player's view.

name: Ghost Fleet
text: Round 3 or later: have 5 or more non-fighter ships outside your home system, none of them in any other player's view.

name: Hidden Shipyard
text: Have a space dock outside your home system that no other player has in view.

name: Dark Colony
text: Control 3 planets outside your home system, in systems no other player has in view.

name: Shroud the Throne
text: Round 3 or later: no other player has your home system in view.

name: Secret Passage
text: Have ships in 2 systems that share a wormhole type, while no other player has either system in view.

name: Lurk in the Nebula
text: Have 3 or more non-fighter ships in a nebula that no other player has in view.

name: Eyes on the Throne
text: Have the home systems of 2 other players in your view.

name: Watch the Leader
text: Have in your view the home system of another player who has the most victory points, with at least 3. If players are tied, any of them counts.

name: Shadow Every Rival
text: Have units of 4 different other players in your view.

name: Mark the Flagships
text: Have the flagships of 2 other players in your view.

name: Cast a Wide Net
text: Have ships in 5 systems, none of them adjacent to another of those systems.

name: Strike From the Fog
text: Win a space combat against a player who, at the start of your tactical action, did not have any of the systems your ships moved from in view.

name: Appear From Nowhere
text: Move ships into a system adjacent to another player's home system, from systems that player did not have in view at the start of your tactical action.

name: Into the Unknown
text: Win a combat or gain control of a planet in a system you had not found at the start of your tactical action.

name: Blind Them
text: Destroy another player's last ships in a system, leaving that player with no view of it.

name: Silent Landing
text: Gain control of a planet in a system that no other player has in view at the end of your tactical action.

name: Long Range Recon
text: Find 3 systems you had not found before, during a single tactical action.

name: Witness the Fall
text: Have in your view a space combat you are not part of, in which a player loses their last ships in that system.

name: Join the Consensus
text: Vote for the outcome that is elected, after at least 2 other players already voted for it.

name: Kingmaker
text: Cast votes that decide an agenda: without your votes, a different outcome would have won or tied.

name: Read the Room
text: Vote for the elected outcome of both agendas in the same agenda phase.

name: Cast the Deciding Word
text: As the speaker, break a tie to decide an agenda's outcome.
